Benyamin fiefoɔ ne Saulo fiefoɔ
1 # Gye 46.21 Na Benyamin woo Bela, n’abakan, Asbel a ɔtɔ so mmienu ne Ahra a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa, 2Noha a ɔtɔ so nnan ne Rafa a ɔtɔ so nnum. 3Na Bela mma ne: Adar, Gera, Abihud, 4Abisua, Naaman, Ahoa 5Gera, Sefufan ne Huram. 6Na yeinom ne Ehud mma, (yeinom ne Gebafoɔ agyanom atitire, na wɔtuu wɔn kɔɔ Manahat), 7ne Naaman ne Ahia ne Gera, ɔno na ɔtuu wɔn kɔeɛ, na ɔwoo Usa ne Ahihud. 8Na Saharaim woe wɔ Moab asase so, nso na wagya ne yerenom Husim ne Baara kwan. 9Na ɔne ne yere Hodes woo Yobab, Sibia, Mesa, Malkam 10Yeus, Sakia ne Mirma. Yeinom ne ne mma a wɔyɛ agyanom atitire. 11Na ɔne Husim woo Abitub ne Elpaal. 12Na Elpaal mma ne: Eber, Misam ne Semed a ɔkyekyeree Ono ne Lod ne ɛho nkurowa, 13Beria ne Sema, (wɔn ne Ayalonfoɔ agyanom atitire, wɔn na wɔpamm Gatfoɔ). 14Na Ahio, Sasak, Yeremot, 15Sebadia, Arad, Eder, 16Mikael, Yispa, Yoha ne Beria mma. 17Na Sebadia, Mesulam, Hiski, Heber, 18Ismerai, Yislia, Yobab ne Elpaal mma. 19Na Yakim, Sikri, Sabdi, 20Elienai, Siletai, Eliel, 21Adaia, Beraia, Simrat ne Simei mma. 22Na Yispan, Eber, Eliel, 23Abdon, Sikri, Hanan, 24Hanania, Elam, Antotia, 25Yifdeia, Penuel ne Sasak mma. 26Na Samserai, Seharia, Atalia, 27Yaaresia, Elia, Sikri ne Yeroham mma. 28Yeinom ne agyanom atitire, wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so atitire. Yeinom tenaa Yerusalem.
29 # 1 Be 9.35-44 Na wɔn a wɔtenaa Gibeon ne Gibean n’agya Yeiel a ne yere din de Maaka, 30ne n’abakan Abdon, Sur, Kis, Baal, Nadab, 31Gedor, Ahio ne Seker. 32Na Miklot woo Simea; na wɔn nso wɔtenaa wɔn nuanom ntentensoɔ Yerusalem kaa wɔn nuanom ho.
33 # 1 Sa 14.51 Na Ner woo Kis, na Kis woo Saulo, na Saulo woo Yonatan, Malkisua, Abinadab ne Esbaal. 34Na Yonatan ba ne Merib-baal, na Merib-baal woo Mika. 35Na Mika mma ne: Piton, Melek, Tarea ne Ahas. 36Na Ahas woo Yehoada, na Yehoada woo Alemet, Asmawet ne Simri. Na Simri woo Mosa. 37Na Mosa woo Binea, ne Rafa, ne Elasa, ne Asel. 38Na Asel wɔ mmammarima baasia, na wɔn din nie: Asrikam, Bokeru, Ismael, Searia, Obadia ne Hanan. Yeinom nyinaa yɛ Asel mma. 39Na ne nua Esek mma ne: N’abakan Ulam, Yeus a ɔtɔ so mmienu, ne Elifelet a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa. 40#1 Be 12.2 Na Ulam mma yɛ mmarima ahoɔdenfoɔ a wɔtumi wɔn ho, wɔkuntunu tadua, na wɔwɔ mma bebree ne mma mma ɔha aduonum. Yeinom nyinaa yɛ Benyamin mma asefoɔ.

Na Benyamin woo Bela, n’abakan, Asbel a ɔtɔ so mmienu ne Ahra a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa, Noha a ɔtɔ so nnan ne Rafa a ɔtɔ so nnum. Na Bela mma ne: Adar, Gera, Abihud, Abisua, Naaman, Ahoa Gera, Sefufan ne Huram. Na yeinom ne Ehud mma, (yeinom ne Gebafoɔ agyanom atitire, na wɔtuu wɔn kɔɔ Manahat), ne Naaman ne Ahia ne Gera, ɔno na ɔtuu wɔn kɔeɛ, na ɔwoo Usa ne Ahihud. Na Saharaim woe wɔ Moab asase so, nso na wagya ne yerenom Husim ne Baara kwan. Na ɔne ne yere Hodes woo Yobab, Sibia, Mesa, Malkam Yeus, Sakia ne Mirma. Yeinom ne ne mma a wɔyɛ agyanom atitire. Na ɔne Husim woo Abitub ne Elpaal. Na Elpaal mma ne: Eber, Misam ne Semed a ɔkyekyeree Ono ne Lod ne ɛho nkurowa, Beria ne Sema, (wɔn ne Ayalonfoɔ agyanom atitire, wɔn na wɔpamm Gatfoɔ). Na Ahio, Sasak, Yeremot, Sebadia, Arad, Eder, Mikael, Yispa, Yoha ne Beria mma. Na Sebadia, Mesulam, Hiski, Heber, Ismerai, Yislia, Yobab ne Elpaal mma. Na Yakim, Sikri, Sabdi, Elienai, Siletai, Eliel, Adaia, Beraia, Simrat ne Simei mma. Na Yispan, Eber, Eliel, Abdon, Sikri, Hanan, Hanania, Elam, Antotia, Yifdeia, Penuel ne Sasak mma. Na Samserai, Seharia, Atalia, Yaaresia, Elia, Sikri ne Yeroham mma. Yeinom ne agyanom atitire, wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so atitire. Yeinom tenaa Yerusalem.
Na wɔn a wɔtenaa Gibeon ne Gibean n’agya Yeiel a ne yere din de Maaka, ne n’abakan Abdon, Sur, Kis, Baal, Nadab, Gedor, Ahio ne Seker. Na Miklot woo Simea; na wɔn nso wɔtenaa wɔn nuanom ntentensoɔ Yerusalem kaa wɔn nuanom ho.
Na Ner woo Kis, na Kis woo Saulo, na Saulo woo Yonatan, Malkisua, Abinadab ne Esbaal. Na Yonatan ba ne Merib-baal, na Merib-baal woo Mika. Na Mika mma ne: Piton, Melek, Tarea ne Ahas. Na Ahas woo Yehoada, na Yehoada woo Alemet, Asmawet ne Simri. Na Simri woo Mosa. Na Mosa woo Binea, ne Rafa, ne Elasa, ne Asel. Na Asel wɔ mmammarima baasia, na wɔn din nie: Asrikam, Bokeru, Ismael, Searia, Obadia ne Hanan. Yeinom nyinaa yɛ Asel mma. Na ne nua Esek mma ne: N’abakan Ulam, Yeus a ɔtɔ so mmienu, ne Elifelet a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa. Na Ulam mma yɛ mmarima ahoɔdenfoɔ a wɔtumi wɔn ho, wɔkuntunu tadua, na wɔwɔ mma bebree ne mma mma ɔha aduonum. Yeinom nyinaa yɛ Benyamin mma asefoɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
